edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the depositor and aToken beneficiary in deposit.
msg.sender must equal the reserve aToken address in onlyOverlyingAToken.
msg.sender is passed to calculateUserGlobalData and updateStateOnBorrow.
msg.sender is recorded as the repayer in repay.
msg.sender determines the user whose collateral flag is set.
msg.sender executes the liquidation delegatecall.
msg.sender participates in the flash loan guards and state updates.
onlyLendingPool requires lendingPoolAddress == msg.sender before transferring.
onlyLendingPool requires lendingPoolAddress == msg.sender before fee transfer.
onlyLendingPool requires lendingPoolAddress == msg.sender before pulling funds.
msg.sender is the redeeming user in AToken.redeem.
isOwner compares msg.sender with the stored owner.
changeAdmin is reachable only when msg.sender equals the stored admin.
ifAdmin branches on msg.sender == _admin() to authorize admin functions.
block.timestamp is emitted in the Deposit event.
Interest accrual depends on block.timestamp minus the last update timestamp.

Reserve lastUpdateTimestamp is written from block.timestamp.

updateStateOnRedeem refreshes interest rates and timestamp.

normalization_plan.reason: The amount parameter only exists as input to deposit and should be folded into the deposit function node.
The reserve parameter is solely used inside borrow for storage selection and checks.
The payback amount local is a transient computation completely contained in repay.
The receiver parameter is the target of the flash loan callback and belongs to flashLoan.
The balance increase local is computed and consumed only within cumulateBalanceInternal.
The user parameter is only used to index state inside balanceOf.
The data parameter is only meaningful as the payload of the upgrade delegatecall.
The local counter is a guard implementation detail of the nonReentrant modifier.
The new implementation parameter only feeds proxy creation or upgrade inside updateImplInternal.
